# OrdinaryDiffEq OperatorSplitting.jl

## Why this package?
* First open source package for operator splitting
* Focussed on flexibility

## Features
* Adaptive timestepping
* Interpolation
* Callbacks
* Arbitrary splitting

## SciML design
* export `OperatorSplittingProblem
* Each integrator can operate on arbitrary subset of states
* support standard `init`/`solve`

## Solver flexibility`
* Tree of integrators
* solvers define a `perform_step!` and everything else comes free
